title: ButlerProposal
description: butler.proposal.v1 -- what a model may return for a sealed butler.context.v1 packet (docs/BUTLER_ARCHITECTURE.md section 4). IDs and enums ONLY: no answer, summary, number, URL, tool name, approval, confidence, HTML or new memory field. Passing this schema proves shape, never truth: trackr-backend/app/research/butler_validation.py additionally checks every reference against the sealed packet and the caller's CURRENT access, and only then renders reviewed templates. A proposal that fails anything is rejected whole and never shown as a partial answer.

abstain_code.description: Null when something is selected. An empty selection with a null abstain_code is invalid; a non-null code with a selection is invalid. Permission failures are never an abstention -- the server handles them before invocation and at submission.
